incoming.name: Venus
incoming.excerpt: While rainfall drives thunderstorms on Earth, there is no rainfall on Venus.

outgoing.name: Rainforest
outgoing.excerpt: Thunderstorms occur throughout the world, even in the polar regions, with the greatest frequency in tropical rainforest areas, where they may occur nearly daily.
